# Account

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Create an account

- **What it is:** Create a Whatsable account with a name, a work email and a password; the WhatsApp number asked there is only for setup help, not the number you connect.
- **Plan:** Every plan. Right after sign-up the person chooses the 14-day Pro trial with a card, or continues free.
- **Who can do it:** Anyone. The person signs up themselves.
- **Where:** https://console.whatsable.app/sign-up > Create account
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started.md, section "create-your-account". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started#create-your-account

## Sign up to connect an AI app

- **What it is:** A sign-up for connecting an AI app to Whatsable: no setup questions, and it opens Connect your AI.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency, the 14-day trial and the Free plan. It starts on the 14-day trial with no card, then the Free plan. It skips the setup questions and opens Connect your AI.
- **Who can do it:** Anyone signs up. Only an owner or an admin connects an AI app.
- **Where:** Connect your AI
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/plans.md, section "sign-up". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/plans#sign-up

## Sign in

- **What it is:** Sign in with an email address and a password, then a six-digit code when two-step verification is on.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Every user, with their own login.
- **Where:** https://console.whatsable.app/sign-in
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/account-security.md, section "sign-in-with-a-code". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/account-security#sign-in-with-a-code

## Reset a password

- **What it is:** Email a reset link from the sign-in page and set a new password.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Every user, for their own login.
- **Where:** https://console.whatsable.app/forgot-password > Send reset link
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started.md, section "reset-your-password". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started#reset-your-password

## Verify an email address

- **What it is:** An optional check that the sign-in email reaches the person; the link works for 24 hours.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Every user, for their own login.
- **Where:** The menu under your name, at the bottom of the sidebar > Account security > Send verification email
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/account-security.md, section "verify-your-email-address". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/account-security#verify-your-email-address

## Two-step verification

- **What it is:** A code from an authenticator app at sign-in, with 10 single-use recovery codes.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Every user, for their own login. Nobody can require it for others.
- **Where:** The menu under your name, at the bottom of the sidebar > Account security > Two-step verification > Turn on
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/account-security.md, section "two-step-verification". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/account-security#two-step-verification

## The setup questions after sign-up

- **What it is:** The questions after sign-up: website, role, goals, volume, experience, tools and how they found Whatsable. Only the role needs an answer.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** The person who signed up. An invited teammate answers none.
- **Where:** https://console.whatsable.app/onboarding
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started.md, section "answer-the-setup-questions". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started#answer-the-setup-questions

## Rename the organization or set its language

- **What it is:** The organization's name, as the team and invitation emails show it, and its language.
- **Plan:** Every plan. The API and the MCP server cannot rename an organization.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Organization > Organization name > Rename
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started.md, section "rename-your-organization". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started#rename-your-organization

## The Get started checklist

- **What it is:** The setup checklist: connect WhatsApp, connect tools, create the AI agent, go live.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Everyone in the organization can open it.
- **Where:** Get started
- **The agent can:** read where the account is in its setup with `get_setup_status`
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started.md, section "follow-the-get-started-checklist". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/get-started#follow-the-get-started-checklist

## The Connect your AI page

- **What it is:** The page that adds Whatsable to an AI app and connects WhatsApp, for an organization that signed up to connect an AI app.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency, the 14-day trial and the Free plan. It shows for an organization that signed up to connect an AI app, and stays available on the Free plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins. A member cannot connect an AI app.
- **Where:** Connect your AI
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/plans.md, section "sign-up". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/mcp/plans#sign-up
